title: Three layers of tourism supply
note: Note: Table 2.13 gives each layer's question and categories. Infrastructure Report, Jul 2026, p9.
deck_only_values: The nesting order (Attractions innermost, Services, Enabling infrastructure outermost) is taken from Infrastructure Report p9; v15 lists the layers in that order but does not describe the nesting.
conflicts: Deck p9 labels the outer layer 'Infrastructure'; v15 calls it 'Enabling infrastructure'. v15 followed.

Deck p9 words the three readings differently (people do not come; people do not stay or spend; not enough demand for the region). The figure uses v15's wording from the paragraph beginning 'The Infrastructure Report treats supply as three layers'.
lead_in: The layers nest, and a weak one fails in its own way (Figure 2.14).
